exit_criteria.description: The exact master-plan digest has three recorded human functional approvals.
A distinct reviewer run records no blocking ambiguity against the approved repository head.
The approved master plan is merged to the protected engineering baseline at the reviewed digest.
The v2 milestone migration is merged, CI-green, and recorded on the protected baseline.
Recovered source is committed on the intended private repository baseline.
A clean Python 3.12 checkout installs, tests, and builds reproducibly.
Required CI, branch protection, merge policy, and independent review controls pass on the protected baseline.
Current files and reachable repository history contain no credential material.
Previously exposed DeepSeek and EigenField credentials are rotated and replacements are stored only in an approved secret store.
UNKNOWN evidence remains distinct from an observed measured null and cannot support a material PASS.
Policy activation cannot strand Programs; governed binding migration or an explicit legacy path fails closed.
Formal Program route remains UNSELECTED before the authorized F5 route decision.
Submitted dissent is immutable, attributable, evidence-bound, and cannot be omitted by the policy caller.
One authorized work item moves from READY to an independently reviewed pull request without another prompt.
Forced crash, lease expiry, checkpoint resume, and replay protection create no duplicate commit or event.
Protected-path refusal, kill switch, budget ceilings, secret isolation, and audit evidence pass.
Postgres persists immutable versions, events, and a transactional outbox.
OIDC or service identity enforces program-scoped authorization and human approval roles.
Idempotency, restart recovery, optimistic concurrency, and two-writer conflict tests pass.
Exactly one restricted commit service path changes formal Program state.
Raw artifacts remain external and are represented by immutable authorized pointers.
Authenticated operator UX retrieves and displays durable state without chat reconstruction.
Corrected evidence, result, measured-null, gap, dissent, challenge, and successor-session contracts are enforced.
Axiom-first mock seats complete a frozen, blind, challenged, independently reviewed F0 Crucible.
Exact human approval gates one atomic synthetic commit.
Material UNKNOWN, FAIL, dissent, stale input, wrong role, expiry, and self-approval fail closed.
Duplicate and reordered synthetic commands do not duplicate or regress state.
All outputs and UX label the result only as a synthetic Conclave harness.
Live seats use versioned prompts/models, distinct run identities, and seat-specific tool envelopes.
Structured outputs, traces, limits, reproducibility manifests, and bounded failures are enforced.
Live seats reproduce the synthetic F0 flow without gaining approval, commit, policy, or evidence-promotion authority.
Authenticated humans approve exact immutable packets and atomic commit rechecks Axiom.
Live-seat outage, malformed output, timeout, and partial-session recovery remain visible and safe.
One synthetic Sentinel evidence event maps to one Program exactly once.
A governed decisive-work order binds prediction, alternatives, falsifier, kill criterion, protocol, rights, budget, owner, deadline, and QC.
Result/QC ingestion preserves positive, negative, null, contradictory, failed-QC, and failed-replication outcomes.
Failure attribution and learn-back create a successor snapshot and Crucible without overwriting history.
The full 18-step closed-loop and adversarial suite passes through authenticated staging UX and API.
Crash, replay, state-conflict, connector failure, and operator recovery paths pass visibly.
Only the Evidence Steward has purpose-bound read-only EigenField access inside a Crucible.
Immutable EvidencePackets preserve provenance, rights, contradictions, nulls, dependency, staleness, and one snapshot root.
The Eigen-1 gateway produces versioned MODEL_PREDICTION/L3 records with calibration, OOD, leakage, and frozen inputs.
F0-F2 TPP, disease-map, evidence-audit, and causal-question policies fail closed.
One authorized CRC or PRAD dry run produces traceable F0-F2 packets; model output never satisfies an experimental gate.
Approved public and private Sentinel connectors preserve quarantine, rights, lineage, deduplication, change detection, and replay.
F3-F8 model, assay, mechanism, target, route, modality, asset, rights, execution, investment, and nomination policies/workspaces are complete.
Six executable routes compare against one frozen TPP without averaging away a hard failure.
Existing-asset or rescue and de novo routes each complete governed F0-F8 dry runs with no gate skips.
A nominated package is third-party readable, reproducible, controllable, transferable, and financeable.
Portfolio and Opportunity Radar controls enforce capacity, correlated risk, reserves, catalysts, expiries, and upstream stability.
F9-F12 policies and artifact contracts cover IND-enabling, human proof, clinical proof, registration, externalization, lifecycle, and termination.
Required clinical, regulatory, safety, quality, legal, finance, and executive approval paths are explicit and enforced.
Every enabled integration boundary, failure route, hold, expiry, and transition path passes a synthetic or approved retrospective dry run.
No software dry run changes or is reported as real therapeutic Program advancement.
Security, authorization, prompt-injection, secret-handling, and protected-operation suites pass.
Backup, restore, rollback, release recovery, and data-integrity tests pass.
Observability, connector recovery, operational controls, alerts, and soak pass against the exact deployed release.
CRC and PRAD current-gate packages regenerate without chat history and both route dry runs remain reproducible.
A transferable package passes third-party review and no enabled gate has undefined policy.
The qualified release, CI, deployment, acceptance, and rollback artifacts are immutably recorded.

blockers.description: Credentials previously exposed in chat must be revoked, rotated, and installed by an authorized human before live integration.
Private repository visibility, branch protection, required checks, and merge policy require repository-admin verification.
